jobs.name: critters-1.png
jobs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate production artwork for Hay Bale Brawl, a cosy woodland auto-battler. Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its soft detailed storybook gouache, round cute bodies, rich warm colours and delicate dark-plum outlines, slightly thicker for readability at 50 pixels tall. Do NOT copy its weapons, scarves or background. Images 2 and 3 are IDENTITY REFERENCES ONLY for Dora and Enzo, not photographic style.
Dora ivory-white chinchilla with very dark ruby-burgundy eyes, nearly black, never pink/glowing. Enzo grey chinchilla, white chest, black eyes. Pip lavender-grey young chinchilla with black eyes, eager and wide-eyed. Duchess honey-gold chinchilla, small three-point golden crown, gracious chin raised.
Every creature is cuddly, charming, never scary, injured or bloody. Soft upper-left light. No text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, borders or grid lines anywhere. PNG exactly 1536x1024.

Transparent character sprite sheet, an invisible 4-column by 3-row grid, twelve equal 384x341-ish cells. Exactly ONE critter per cell. All face RIGHT in a three-quarter side view. FULL silhouettes including tails, paws, ears, quills and whiskers stay inside each cell with AT LEAST 10% clear space on ALL four sides. Feet near each cell's bottom safe margin. Body mass fills similar share of cell for ALL species: ladybird/wren as readable as chinchilla. Bold simple silhouettes, no excessive tiny details. Actual transparent alpha zero background with NO coloured background, paper rectangle, glow, haze or ground/cast shadow.
Read LEFT to RIGHT, TOP to BOTTOM:
Row1: Wren, round brown with cocked tail cheerful; Field Mouse, tan big pink ears long curled tail; Ladybird, red black-spotted upright mascot on little legs with two antennae; Toad, warty olive-brown wide grin sturdy.
Row2: Bee, fuzzy yellow-black bumblebee small wings plucky; Dormouse, round golden-orange sleepy half-closed eyes fluffy tail; Hedgehog, brown spines cream face determined; Squirrel, red ear tufts huge bushy tail holding acorn.
Row3: Robin, plump orange-red breast puffed proud; Mole, velvety dark-grey pink nose big pink digging paws squinting; Frog, bright green crouched to leap big eyes; Pip, lavender-grey young chinchilla eager and poised for a little hop.
No other subjects.
